Continue study · Object ↔ file

A Garment Can Outlive Its File

A garment and its digital record are interdependent preservation systems: the object carries material evidence the file cannot feel, while the file carries context the object cannot state.

Read the exhibition

00

The proposition

A garment can survive after its pattern software, photographs, emails, or product database disappear. A file can survive after fabric degrades, components separate, or ownership changes. Smithsonian textile-conservation guidance addresses physical care; National Archives resources address electronic-record preservation. These are authoritative starting points in their domains, not individualized conservation instructions for a private collection.

The institutional unit is therefore the object–file relationship. Stable identifiers connect garment, components, labels, condition, dimensions, materials, pattern, construction records, images, rights, contributor accounts, loans, treatments, exhibitions, and digital derivatives. Access and privacy may require layers. Valuable or fragile textiles require a qualified conservator, while obsolete digital formats require migration planning and integrity checks.

01–04

The institutional sequence

01 · IDENTIFY

Can object and file find each other?

Assign stable identifiers to garment, component, container, digital folder, preservation copy, image, and related record; never rely on filename or shelf memory alone.

PROPOSALS39S41

02 · DESCRIBE

What evidence belongs to each medium?

Record physical material, construction, wear and condition separately from file provenance, format, metadata, rights, version, and fixity. Link without collapsing.

INFERENCES42S66

03 · CARE

What threatens survival?

Assess handling, light, pests, humidity, storage materials, damage, hardware, software, format, bit integrity, access, vendor, and backup with appropriate specialists.

VERIFIEDS41S42S43S66

04 · USE

How will access avoid harm?

Define handling, digitization, research, display, reproduction, privacy, cultural restriction, loan, treatment, and correction rules; record every intervention.

PROPOSALS40S42

COUNTERPOINT

What this framework could get wrong

Digitization can create access while encouraging the fiction that the physical object has been preserved. Conservation can protect an object while making it inaccessible. Stewardship must negotiate both forms of loss.

FIELDWORK

Do the work now

Use this as a working session, not a score.

  1. Pair one garment with every known physical and digital relative.
  2. Create identifiers and record missing connections.
  3. Obtain conservation and digital-preservation risk assessments.
  4. Test recovery from a preservation copy and retrieval from physical storage.

Reading protocol

Every material statement carries an evidence label and point-of-claim source links. Interpretation is never presented as source fact. Legal sections identify their jurisdiction; state, foreign, contractual, beneficial-ownership, validity, priority, and disputed-fact questions remain counsel-review gates. This exhibition is educational and does not provide legal, conservation, or business advice.
